sampleRequirement: Each proof-bearing logical true result must bind the same device and sample generation to a finite nonzero concrete-state projection emitted after physical-poll original return.
transactionAmbiguityPolicy: A same-family transaction with more than one proof-eligible action is ignored and its witness proves no action. Cross-family or consumer-site contradictions fail the run. Every required action needs a separate exactly-one-candidate transaction.

requiredRuns.instruction: For each action perform neutral, held for at least three complete raw samples, then released for at least three complete raw samples; repeat twice. Every action must show inactive-to-active and active-to-inactive projection transitions and at least one exactly-one-candidate consumer transaction. Diagonal multi-action transactions are allowed but do not count.

Use separated single activations and rapid taps with an idle window between action groups; require a finite nonzero same-sample projection and exactly-one-candidate consumer transaction for each proof-bearing activation.

Repeat the held/release matrix with controller 0 and a unique Gamepad owner only. Every action must show inactive-to-active and active-to-inactive projection transitions and at least one exactly-one-candidate consumer transaction. Diagonal multi-action transactions are allowed but do not count.

Repeat the separated single and rapid edge matrix with controller 0 and a unique Gamepad owner only; require a finite nonzero same-sample projection and exactly-one-candidate consumer transaction for each proof-bearing activation.
